§6Watz Power Plant§f

§aThe worst power-to-cost ratio in the mod. You build it for the mud, not the watts.§f

The §bWatz§f is a single-body fission reactor similar to the ZIRNOX, but costs late-game resources and produces barely §e5 MHE/s§f on its best fuel. That is ZIRNOX territory. The real reason to build one is §bPoisonous Mud§f, which you need for §bCMB Steel§f.

§6How It Runs§f:
§b•§f Place a §bPressure Pump§f on top, supply a redstone signal
§b•§f Cold coolant in through the top, hot coolant + poisonous mud out the bottom
§b•§f Fuel pellets go in the GUI. No boiling water directly, you need a separate heat exchanger
§b•§f Depletes fuel agonizingly slowly. Great for servers, useless for breeding

§6Construction§f: 1 Core Component, 26 Supercoolers, 36 Reaction Chambers, 48 Stability Elements, 192 High-Speed Steel Bolts, and a Pneumatic Rivet Gun. Watz units stack vertically and a single pump controls the whole stack.

§6Fuels§f: MEU, MEP, HEN, and schrabidium-based. Absorber pellets boost poisonous mud output.

§cWARNING:§f If the poisonous mud buffer fills, it melts down hard. Corrosive mud sprays everywhere. Keep the output flowing!
